findings.summary: The Danish paragraph called electrical power electrical energy.
evidence: The previous text began Elektrisk energi, although the source defines a rate of energy transfer.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Elektrisk effekt and clarified varmeflux as the relevant heat-transfer term.

findings.summary: The practical-checks sentence repeated strøm where the source requires power.
evidence: The previous text said den forventede strøm og strøm, omitting the distinction between current and power.
findings.resolution: Changed the pair to den forventede strøm og effekt and added a natural safety-margin phrase.
